霍尔木兹海峡再有油轮遇袭，伊朗称两船触雷

Tankers hit in Hormuz as Iran keeps up pressure after US vote

Iran reported three more tankers damaged in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, with the IRGC saying two had struck naval mines and another had caught fire. At least five vessels have reported incidents since Sunday, according to UKMTO, close to the record pace of October, when 35 vessels were hit. Oil prices, down more than $20 a barrel over the week, bounced slightly on Thursday.

伊朗方面称，周四又有三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡受损，伊斯兰革命卫队表示其中两艘触及水雷，另一艘起火。据英国海上贸易行动办公室统计，自周日以来至少已有五艘船报告遇袭，接近 10 月份 35 艘船遇袭的纪录节奏。油价一周内下跌逾 20 美元后，周四略有反弹。

卡塔尔以北海域一油轮遭两枚不明发射物袭击

Tanker struck by two projectiles off Qatar, crew status unknown

A tanker was struck by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nautical miles north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar, at 23:20 UTC on Wednesday, according to UKMTO. The report has been verified, but the status of the crew, the extent of damage and any environmental impact are unconfirmed, and the vessel and its flag were not identified. No one has claimed responsibility, and vessels in the area have been advised to transit with caution.

一艘油轮在卡塔尔 Madinat ash Shamal 以北约 50 海里处遭两枚不明发射物击中，事发时间为周三 23:20 UTC。英国海上贸易行动办公室表示报告已核实，但船员状况、受损程度和环境影响均未确认，也未公布船名与船旗。目前无人宣称负责，英方提醒该水域船舶谨慎航行并报告可疑活动。

03海事安全 / 法规 · 2026年11月5日

芬兰判处波罗的海电缆破坏案船长三年半监禁

Finland jails captain and crew member over Baltic cable sabotage

A Helsinki court has jailed the Russian captain of the cargo ship Fitburg for three and a half years and its Azerbaijani boatswain for two years and ten months for aggravated sabotage over damage to two subsea telecom cables in the Gulf of Finland. Investigators found the vessel dragged a damaged anchor and chain along the seabed for about 130 km on New Year's Eve, severing two Finland–Estonia cables and crossing seven more cables and a gas pipeline. The two were ordered to pay about €1.9m in damages; the verdict is not final and the captain will appeal.

芬兰赫尔辛基地方法院判处普通货船 Fitburg 的俄罗斯船长三年半监禁、阿塞拜疆水手长两年十个月监禁，罪名是去年除夕夜在芬兰湾故意损坏两条海底电信电缆。调查认定该船将损坏的锚与锚链在海底拖行约 130 公里，损坏了两条芬兰—爱沙尼亚电缆，还穿越了另外七条电信与电力电缆及一条天然气管道。两人须共同赔偿约 190 万欧元，判决尚未生效，船长表示将上诉。

04法规 / 制裁 · 2026年11月5日

欧盟法院裁定俄船级社取得部分制裁胜诉

EU court hands Russian Maritime Register partial sanctions victory

The EU General Court has ruled that the EU's permanent withdrawal of recognition from the Russian Maritime Register of Shipping was disproportionate, holding that suspending recognition would have achieved the same aim, and annulled the withdrawal. The court rejected most of the register's other challenges, including those against financial restrictions, while its port-access ban challenge was ruled inadmissible. The ruling does not immediately restore its operating rights in Europe, and the effects of the annulled measure are temporarily preserved.

欧盟普通法院裁定，欧盟永久撤销俄罗斯海事登记局认可的决定不合比例，暂停认可即可达到同样目的，因此撤销该项决定；但法院驳回了该机构的大部分申诉，包括针对金融限制的异议，港口准入禁令的申诉则因不可受理被驳回。裁决不会立即恢复其在欧洲的运营权利，被撤销措施的效力暂时保留。

05法规 / 国际海事组织 · 2026年11月5日

多明格斯获提名连任国际海事组织秘书长

Dominguez gets nod for second term at IMO helm

The IMO Council has backed Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez for a second four-year term, from 1 January 2028 to 31 December 2031, subject to formal approval by the IMO Assembly in late 2027. Dominguez, who took office in January 2024, has spent much of his first term navigating divisions over shipping decarbonisation: the IMO Net-Zero Framework, which would introduce a global marine fuel standard and emissions pricing, was delayed by a year in October 2025 after opposition from the US, Saudi Arabia and others, with key talks resuming at MEPC from 30 November to 3 December and an extraordinary session on 4 December.

国际海事组织理事会支持秘书长 Arsenio Dominguez 连任，第二个任期为 2028 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 31 日，尚待 2027 年底 IMO 大会正式批准。Dominguez 自 2024 年 1 月上任，任内主要应对航运脱碳分歧：IMO 净零框架原定引入全球船用燃料标准与排放定价机制，但 2025 年 10 月因美国、沙特等国反对被推迟一年采用，新一轮关键谈判将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日海保会及 12 月 4 日特别会议上继续。

马士基三度上调全年盈利预期

Maersk upgrades profit outlook despite underperforming rivals

Maersk has raised its full-year earnings guidance for the third time this year, now expecting underlying EBITDA of $14–14.5bn for 2026, up from $10.5–12.5bn, and underlying operating profit of $8–8.5bn. Third-quarter revenue climbed 27% year on year to $18.1bn, EBITDA surged from $2.7bn to $4.7bn, and the ocean division generated operating profits of $2.6bn. Analysts nonetheless flagged weaker performance against peers: its ocean operating margin of 20.6% compared with 21.6% at ONE and 28.8% at COSCO's container division, while volumes fell 0.8% against growth of 4.5% at both rivals.

马士基今年第三次上调全年盈利指引，预计 2026 年基本 EBITDA 为 140–145 亿美元（此前为 105–125 亿美元），基本经营利润 80–85 亿美元。三季度营收同比增长 27% 至 181 亿美元，EBITDA 从 27 亿增至 47 亿美元，海运业务经营利润 26 亿美元。但分析师指出其表现逊于同行：海运经营利润率 20.6%，低于 ONE 的 21.6% 和中远集运（含 OOCL）的 28.8%；货量下降 0.8%，而 ONE 与中远均增长 4.5%。

长荣重返苏伊士运河，ZIM 愈发孤立

Evergreen's Suez return leaves Zim increasingly isolated

Taiwan's Evergreen is preparing to send its first ships through the Suez Canal after almost three years of avoiding the Red Sea. According to Linerlytica, Evergreen will deploy the 16,556 teu Ever Eon and Ever Edit through Suez on 7 and 11 November on the Ocean Alliance's NEU7/CES service, followed by the 20,124 teu Ever Gifted on 16 November. Evergreen was the last Ocean Alliance member holding out against a return; all three major alliances and MSC are on course to restore their Suez networks by the first quarter of 2027, leaving Israeli carrier ZIM as the most prominent remaining holdout. Xeneta has estimated a comprehensive return to Suez could release 6%–8% of global containership capacity.

台湾长荣海运准备近三年来首次恢复经苏伊士运河航行。据 Linerlytica，长荣将于 11 月 7 日和 11 日分别派 16,556 TEU 的 Ever Eon、Ever Edit 经苏伊士运营海洋联盟 NEU7/CES 航线，20,124 TEU 的 Ever Gifted 将于 11 月 16 日跟进。长荣是海洋联盟最后一家恢复苏伊士航线的成员；三大联盟与 MSC 预计到 2027 年一季度全部恢复苏伊士网络，仅剩以色列船公司 ZIM 仍是主要观望者。Xeneta 曾估计全面重返苏伊士将释放全球集装箱运力的 6%–8%。

Singapore's Pacific International Lines has ordered seven 1,400-teu methanol-ready feeder container ships from Huanghai Shipbuilding in China, for delivery in 2029 and 2030, to boost its intra-Asia and Pacific islands services. Navios 新增 2.15 亿美元油轮新造船

Navios adds $215m tanker trio to newbuild pipeline

Navios Maritime Partners has revealed another $215.2m in tanker newbuilding acquisitions, adding a VLCC and two MR product carriers to its fleet investment programme. The three-vessel package comprises a $124m scrubber-fitted VLCC and two scrubber-fitted MR2s for $91.2m, all expected to join the fleet in the second half of 2029, with sellers and yards undisclosed. Navios now lists 21 tanker newbuildings in its pipeline and a fleet of 182 vessels including newbuildings. It also confirmed a $488m acquisition of four 10,100 teu containership newbuildings, taking its charter backlog to $5bn through 2037.

Navios Maritime Partners 在三季报中披露新增 2.152 亿美元油轮新造船收购：一艘 1.24 亿美元的脱硫塔 VLCC 与两艘共 9,120 万美元的 MR2 型成品油轮，均预计 2029 年下半年交付，卖方与船厂未披露。至此其油轮新造船储备共 21 艘，船队总数 182 艘。公司另确认以 4.88 亿美元收购四艘 10,100 TEU 集装箱新造船，租约 backlog 总额达 50 亿美元至 2037 年。

法国港口连遭罢工：码头工人与拖轮船员接连停工

French ports face fresh disruption as dockers and tug crews stage back-to-back strikes

French ports are facing another round of industrial disruption, with a nationwide dockworkers' strike on Thursday, 5 November, followed by a separate 24-hour walkout by harbour tug crews on Friday. The CGT's ports and docks federation called the stoppage, potentially affecting cargo operations at Le Havre, Marseille-Fos, Dunkirk, Rouen, Bordeaux and smaller ports. At Le Havre, container terminals and movable port infrastructure will be disrupted from 6am Thursday until 6am Friday, and marine operations could be severely slowed from 8am Friday to 8am Saturday as tug crews withdraw labour. The tug dispute is linked to concerns over the protection of France's national shipping register and European regulatory policy.

法国港口面临新一轮罢工：码头工会 CGT 港口码头联合会号召 11 月 5 日（周四）全国停工 24 小时，可能影响勒阿弗尔、马赛-福斯、敦刻尔克、鲁昂、波尔多等港口的货物作业；勒阿弗尔港务局警告集装箱码头与可移动港口设施将从周四 6 时至周五 6 时中断。周五海事官员与拖轮船员将举行另一场全国罢工，勒阿弗尔港内作业或严重放缓。拖轮争议与法国船舶登记制度保护及欧盟监管政策有关。

Arkas 港口扩建拟获 1.1 亿美元开发银行融资

Arkas port expansion eyes $110m in development bank financing

Turkish shipping and logistics group Arkas is seeking up to $110m in financing from three multilateral lenders to support a $157m expansion of its Autoport vehicle and general cargo terminal on the Gulf of Izmit. The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has taken a proposed $50m loan through concept review, while the EBRD and the World Bank's IFC have disclosed proposed loans of up to $30m each. The facilities remain subject to approval. The expansion will extend Autoport's berth from 656 to 850 metres, allowing three vessels to be handled simultaneously instead of two; construction began in July.

土耳其航运物流集团 Arkas 正寻求三家多边机构最高 1.1 亿美元融资，以支持其位于伊兹密特湾的 Autoport 汽车与件杂货码头 1.57 亿美元扩建项目：亚洲基础设施投资银行拟贷款 5,000 万美元，欧洲复兴开发银行与世界银行国际金融公司各拟贷款 3,000 万美元，审批尚未完成。扩建将把码头泊位从 656 米延长至 850 米，可同时靠泊三艘船，工程已于 7 月开工。

巴西将圣弗朗西斯科水道 25 年管理权交给 Codeba

Brazil hands Codeba 25-year control of São Francisco waterway

Brazil has handed federal port authority Codeba a 25-year mandate to manage the São Francisco River waterway, advancing plans to restore commercial barge traffic along a 1,371 km corridor connecting the country's northeast with inland agricultural and industrial markets. The agreement, signed between the federal Ministry of Ports and Airports and the Bahia state government, transfers responsibility for the administration, operation, maintenance and rehabilitation of the HN-500 waterway to Codeba, including the Sobradinho navigation lock and small public port facilities along the river. The wider plan targets restoring commercial navigation between Pirapora in Minas Gerais and Juazeiro in Bahia and Petrolina in Pernambuco, as an alternative to road transport for agricultural commodities, fertilisers and other bulk cargo. The ports ministry has previously identified potential throughput of up to 5m tonnes in the first year of renewed operations, though that remains a planning projection; Bahia's governor said physical works are expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with no firm timetable yet for restoring navigation across the full route.

巴西联邦港口与机场部与巴伊亚州政府签署协议，将圣弗朗西斯科河航道（HN-500）25 年的管理权交给联邦港务局 Codeba，涵盖管理、运营、维护与修复，以及 Sobradinho 船闸和沿河小型公共港口设施。计划恢复从米纳斯吉拉斯州 Pirapora 至巴伊亚州 Juazeiro 与伯南布哥州 Petrolina 之间 1,371 公里航道的商业驳船运输，作为农产品、化肥等大宗货物的公路替代方案，并与 Ferrovia Centro-Atlântica、Ferrovia de Integração Oeste-Leste 铁路及巴伊亚沿海港口衔接；港口部此前预计首年潜在吞吐量可达 500 万吨，但这仍是规划预测。巴伊亚州长 Jerônimo Rodrigues 表示实体工程预计 2027 年下半年开始，全线恢复商业通航尚无确定的时间表或新建设合同。

REV LNG 与 Siem 合作在美国东北部供应 LNG 船燃

REV LNG and Siem Car Carriers partner on LNG bunkering in the US Northeast

REV LNG and Siem Car Carriers have announced a partnership to supply LNG to Siem's ships in the US Northeast, starting at the Port of Davisville, Rhode Island. REV made its first LNG delivery in October to the LNG-powered car carrier Siem Aristotle — the first LNG bunkering in Rhode Island and the first LNG fuelling of a car carrier in the US Northeast. REV has completed more than 90 truck-to-ship LNG deliveries to date.

REV LNG 与 Siem Car Carriers 宣布合作，在美国东北部为 Siem 的船舶供应 LNG，首站为罗得岛州戴维斯维尔港。REV 于 10 月首次向 LNG 动力汽车运输船 Siem Aristotle 交付 LNG，这是罗得岛州首次 LNG 加注，也是美国东北部首次为汽车运输船进行 LNG 加注。REV 迄今已完成 90 多次车对船 LNG 交付。

Excelerate 与 AxDo 签署 11 年 LNG 供应协议，支持巴哈马 LNG 枢纽

Excelerate Energy and AxDo Bahamas Announce Long-Term LNG Supply Agreement Supporting Planned Bahamas LNG Hub

Excelerate Energy and AxDo Bahamas (a joint venture of Axpo and Domicisle LNG) have announced an 11-year LNG supply agreement for up to 16 trillion Btu per year, supporting development of the planned Bahamas LNG Hub, an offshore storage and distribution terminal near Grand Bahama. Initial deliveries are expected to begin in 2027 from Excelerate's Jamaica platform, with a floating storage unit deployment in 2028 subject to permitting; the hub is intended to serve marine bunkering, power generation and regional distribution in the Caribbean.

Excelerate Energy 与 AxDo Bahamas（Axpo 与 Domicisle LNG 的合资公司）宣布签署 11 年 LNG 供应协议，每年最多供应 16 万亿英热单位，支持在大巴哈马岛附近建设海上储存与分销终端——巴哈马 LNG 枢纽。首批交付预计 2027 年起从 Excelerate 的牙买加平台发出，浮式储存装置计划 2028 年部署（取决于许可）；枢纽将服务加勒比地区的船舶加注、发电与区域分销。

Fugro 赢得英国海上风电项目勘测合同

Fugro wins survey contract at UK offshore wind project

Dutch geo-data company Fugro has won a contract from Danish offshore wind contractor Cadeler to carry out post-installation seabed surveys at the 960 MW East Anglia Two offshore wind farm in the UK North Sea, starting in early 2027 and covering all 64 monopile locations. The project, developed by ScottishPower Renewables (Iberdrola), is expected to enter commercial operation by the end of 2028 with 64 Siemens Gamesa 15 MW turbines. Cadeler is responsible for transporting and installing the foundations and turbines under a contract worth about €360–382m.

荷兰地质数据公司 Fugro 从丹麦海上风电承包商 Cadeler 手中赢得合同，为英国北海 960 MW East Anglia Two 海上风电场做安装后海底勘测，2027 年初开工，覆盖全部 64 个单桩基础位置。该项目由 ScottishPower Renewables（Iberdrola 旗下）开发，预计 2028 年底商业运营，将安装 64 台 15 MW 西门子歌美飒风机。Cadeler 负责运输安装基础与风机，合同价值约 3.6 亿–3.82 亿欧元。

Deutsche Windtechnik 赢得德国首个海上风电场运维合同

Deutsche Windtechnik lands maintenance deal at Germany's first offshore wind farm

German offshore wind services provider Deutsche Windtechnik has won a comprehensive operations and maintenance contract from Ocean Breeze Energy covering all 12 turbines at the Alpha Ventus wind farm in the North Sea, starting in January 2027 and expanding from September to remote monitoring, marine coordination, grid management and 24-hour alarm handling. Alpha Ventus, which began operating in 2010, is Germany's first offshore wind farm, with 60 MW of capacity about 45 km north of Borkum. Ocean Breeze Energy acquired the wind farm in October from EWE, RWE and Vattenfall and plans to extend its operating life.

德国海上风电服务商 Deutsche Windtechnik 从 Ocean Breeze Energy 赢得综合运维合同，负责北海 Alpha Ventus 风电场全部 12 台风机，2027 年 1 月起执行，9 月起扩展至远程监控、海上协调中心、电网管理与 24 小时报警处理。Alpha Ventus 于 2010 年投运，是德国首个海上风电场，装机 60 MW，位于 Borkum 以北约 45 公里。Ocean Breeze Energy 于 10 月从 EWE、RWE 与 Vattenfall 手中收购该风电场，并计划延长其运营寿命。

Vattenfall 签署 1.8 GW 丹麦海上风电项目最终协议

Vattenfall signs final agreements for 1.8GW Danish offshore wind projects

Sweden's Vattenfall has signed final agreements with the Danish Energy Agency to develop two offshore wind projects totalling at least 1.8 GW: the 800 MW Hesselø project in the Kattegat and the 1 GW Holmsland project (formerly North Sea I Mid) in the North Sea, both expected to enter service in 2032. Vattenfall won the Danish tender in August at DKK 504/MWh (about $78) for Holmsland and DKK 542/MWh (about $84) for Hesselø, with 20 years of price support. Construction still depends on a final investment decision and regulatory approvals. Vattenfall currently operates five offshore wind farms in Denmark, generating about 6.5 TWh a year.

替代燃料船队增长快于加注设施，全球仅 25 港可加甲醇

385 Methanol-Capable Ships Are On Order But Only 25 Ports Worldwide Offer Methanol Bunkering, LR Study Says

Lloyd's Register's new Fuel for Thought: Ports report finds 1,942 alternative-fuel-capable vessels were on order in January 2026, 47% of global orderbook tonnage (Clarksons Research), but bunkering lags badly by fuel: LNG was available at 222 ports versus only 25 actively offering methanol, and the first commercial ammonia bunkering was only completed at Ulsan, South Korea, in April 2026. LR counts 385 methanol-capable and 45 ammonia-capable vessels on order; biofuel drop-in deliveries were recorded at 90 ports, with Singapore alone accounting for more than a quarter of volumes.

劳氏船级社（Lloyd's Register）新发布的《Fuel for Thought: Ports》报告指出，截至 2026 年 1 月，替代燃料船舶在建订单达 1,942 艘，占全球订单总吨位的 47%（Clarksons 数据），但加注设施严重滞后：LNG 加注覆盖 222 个港口，而甲醇加注仅 25 个港口积极提供；首例商业氨加注直至 2026 年 4 月才在韩国蔚山完成。报告统计甲醇动力在建船 385 艘、氨动力 45 艘；生物燃料即用型交付已覆盖 90 个港口，其中新加坡一港占比超过四分之一。

34绿色航运 / 海洋环保 · 2026年11月6日

巴西人用垃圾造船去海上捡更多垃圾

Brazilian builds boat from rubbish to collect more rubbish

A former Brazilian ocean canoeing champion has taken recycling to a floating extreme, constructing a boat from 230 discarded plastic containers so he can collect even more rubbish from the sea. Marcos Arnhold spent two months building the unusual craft in Guaratuba, southern Brazil, using 125 two-litre plastic bottles, 105 five-litre disinfectant containers and a metal roof rack salvaged from an old Volkswagen Kombi. The homemade vessel is destined for Guaratuba Bay and its surrounding mangroves, where Arnhold plans to collect discarded rubbish for delivery to a municipal recycling centre. The vessel currently has a 6.5 hp petrol engine, although Arnhold hopes eventually to add a sail and switch to electric propulsion.

巴西前海洋皮划艇冠军 Marcos Arnhold 用 230 个废弃塑料容器（125 个两升塑料瓶、105 个五升消毒液桶加一个旧大众 Kombi 车顶架）花两个月在巴西南部 Guaratuba 造了一艘船，计划在 Guaratuba 湾及周边红树林收集垃圾送往市政回收中心。船目前配 6.5 马力汽油发动机，未来希望加装风帆并改用电动推进。海洋环保非营利组织 Eyesea 创始人称赞了这一行动，同时指出海洋污染是工业级问题，需要工业级解决方案。

35干散货 / 汽车船 / 能源运输 / 公司战略 · 2026年11月5日

川崎汽船推出 80 亿美元五年投资计划，投资火力翻倍

K Line doubles investment firepower with $8bn five-year plan

Japan's Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (K Line) has unveiled a five-year investment plan of about $8bn (¥1.25trn) for fiscal years 2027–2031, more than double its current ¥610bn strategy. The plan allocates ¥450bn to car carriers, ¥290bn to energy transportation and ¥230bn to dry bulk, plus investment in liquefied CO2 transport, offshore wind, hydrogen and ammonia supply chains and logistics infrastructure. K Line targets group net profit of at least ¥210bn and return on equity above 15% by fiscal 2031. Recurring profit for the half year to September nearly doubled to ¥118.4bn, while its 31%-owned ONE posted second-quarter net profit of $1.32bn and raised its full-year earnings guidance to $2bn.

日本川崎汽船（K Line）公布 2027–2031 财年约 80 亿美元（1.25 万亿日元）投资计划，较现行五年战略的 6,100 亿日元翻倍以上。其中汽车船业务 4,500 亿日元，能源运输 2,900 亿日元，干散货 2,300 亿日元，另投向液化二氧化碳运输、海上风电、氢氨供应链与物流基建。目标到 2031 财年集团净利润至少 2,100 亿日元、净资产收益率超 15%。截至 9 月的半年经常利润近翻倍至 1,184 亿日元；其持股 31% 的 ONE 二季度净利润 13.2 亿美元，并将全年盈利预期上调至 20 亿美元。
